independence.method: Independent signed constitutive/ODE derivation, regularity reconstruction, Hessian and localized-form audit

accepted_exact_claim: The stated diagnostic signed Q static system has a unique local regular positive-density crossing via a state-Lipschitz flux-coordinate IVP. Its phi and rho are C1,1/2 and W2,p forp<2 but notH2; chi is C3,1/2 after the constitutive Holder reconstruction. No delta source occurs. The full continuous Hessian has no standard-H1 coercive lower bound near this crossing; this does not imply a negative direction or absence of weighted/L2 coercivity.

checks.name: flux-coordinate state Lipschitz and two-sided local uniqueness
signed g_x formula on both sides
no flux jump or distributional delta
signed mixed Hessian and boundedH1 form
distinction from weighted orL2 spectral claims

qualification_requiring_explicit_argumen.issue: Continuous T_x=O(sqrt|x|) alone does not establishHolder1/2.
qualification_requiring_explicit_argumen.resolution_in_audit: For v=|B|, writeT=v^(3/2)F(v,a) withF smooth nearv0,a>0. Its derivative is signed sqrt(v) times locally Lipschitz coefficients plus higher-order terms, provingT inC1,1/2 andchi inC3,1/2.

assumptions: Positive finite center density and positive couplings/reference
Even signed Q scalar action and isothermal hydrostatics
Local regular class withrho bounded away fromzero
Induced local walls/mass, no prescribed globalBVP
Fixed positive reference units and zero endpoint perturbations for form countersequence
limitations: No negative eigenmode, weighted-domain closure orL2-gap conclusion
No nonlinear evolution theorem, ghost or ill-posedness claim
No observation/source-discrepancy, metric/photon, RAR/M/filteredMONO orphysicaltheory closure
